selection_process: Selection will be based on the candidate's previous academic/professional record and performance during the interview. The University may also use a seminar

or any other method as part of the selection process. Candidates will need to remain present for the interview as per the schedule published on the official website; no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the official application portal at www.nagpuruniversity.ac.in and locate the Advertisement/Employment Notice section.
Complete registration by clicking on the registration link.
Fill in all necessary information and upload the required photograph, signature, payment receipt, and corresponding documents as specified in the form.
Pay the requisite application fee (Rs. 500/- for Open Category, Rs. 300/- for Reserved Category) through the online payment gateway.
Submit the completed form by clicking the SUBMIT button.
Take a printout of the submitted application form for future reference.
For any queries related to the online application, contact the Helpline Number: 91750 23334 during working hours.
Note: A separate application must be submitted for each post applied for.

content_sections.heading: RTMNU Recruitment 2026 Category-wise Reservation
content_sections.text: Out of the total 139 vacancies, six posts (4%) are reserved for Persons with Disabilities (PwD) - 2 posts for Blindness/Low Vision, 2 posts for Deafness/Hearing Impairment, 1 post for Locomotor Disability categories, and 1 post for Autism/Intellectual Disability/Specific Learning Disability/Mental Illness. One post is additionally reserved for an Orphan candidate.

content_sections.heading: RTMNU Assistant Professor Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Eligibility conditions differ slightly by discipline. The general eligibility applicable to Commerce, Humanities, Education, Law, Social Sciences, Sciences, Languages, Library Science, Physical Education, and Mass Communication is summarized below, along with special conditions for Business Management, Fine Arts, Pharmaceutical Sciences, and the Inter Institutional Computer Centre. General disciplines: Master's degree with 55% marks (or equivalent grade) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university, along with a qualifying NET/SET (or exemption via a Ph.D. awarded as per applicable UGC regulations). Business Management: Bachelor's Degree in any discipline and Master's Degree in Business Administration/PGDM/C.A./ICWA/M.Com with First Class or equivalent, plus two years of professional experience after acquiring the Master's degree. Fine Arts: Master's degree with 55% marks along with NET/SET or Ph.D. as per UGC norms, OR a traditional/professional artist with a Bachelor's degree and specified performance experience as detailed in the official notification. Pharmaceutical Sciences: A basic degree in pharmacy (B. Pharm.), registration as a pharmacist under the applicable Pharmacy Law, and a First Class Master's Degree in the appropriate branch of specialization in pharmacy. Inter Institutional Computer Centre: B.E./B.Tech./B.S. and M.E./M.Tech./M.S. (or Integrated M.Tech.) in a relevant branch with First Class, OR B.E./B.Tech. and MCA with First Class, OR a three-year graduation with Mathematics as a compulsory subject and MCA with First Class along with two years of relevant post-MCA experience. Candidates whose Ph.D. was awarded under the pre-July 2009 regime may be exempted from NET/SET subject to conditions specified in the official notification regarding mode of registration, thesis evaluation, viva voce, and publication/presentation of research work. The upper age limit for all posts is 59 years as on the last date of application.

content_sections.heading: RTMNU Assistant Professor Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 40,000/- per month. The appointment is purely contractual, valid only from the date of joining until 30th April 2027, with no enforceable right to continuation in the succeeding academic session. Selected candidates are permitted only 8 casual leaves during the academic session, with no other leave or allowances admissible.

content_sections.heading: RTMNU Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Fee must be paid online through the payment gateway available on the application portal.

content_sections.heading: RTMNU Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on the candidate's previous academic/professional record and performance during the interview. The University may also use a seminar, colloquium, or any other method as part of the selection process. Candidates will need to remain present for the interview as per the schedule published on the official website; no TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Required Documents for RTMNU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Photograph and signature (as per upload specifications on the portal) Payment receipt Caste certificate, caste validity certificate, and non-creamy layer certificate (wherever applicable) Certificate from a competent authority certifying percentage of marks, where the grading system has been followed Original documents, along with three copies of the submitted application and three copies of self-attested documents, to be carried at the time of interview
